summary: No new defects found by static review. The masked-input fixes and shared-calibration rebuttal are supported by the code and PRD. Required checks and historical failing runs remain unverified because execution was prohibited in this read-only review.

checks.criterion: AC1: Add only NumPy, update uv.lock, and retain passing strict mypy checks.
checks.evidence: pipeline/pyproject.toml:8 adds only numpy; uv.lock:433 and uv.lock:440 add its direct dependency metadata. pyproject.toml:33 retains strict=true. Mypy was not executed because the user prohibited checks in this read-only sandbox.

checks.criterion: AC2: Define the observation-state vocabulary and return values with per-element states and reasons.
checks.evidence: polarimetry.py:47 defines exactly MISSING, INVALID and VALID; line 62 defines string reason codes. StatedArray validates matching shapes, state/reason consistency, finite valid values and NaN unavailable values at lines 127–151. All four public numerical functions return through _Classifier.finish at line 174. Their docstrings state units and conventions.

checks.criterion: AC3: Write and run failing F8–F10 tests before implementation, using the specified values and tolerances.
checks.evidence: test_polarimetry_decode.py:35 sets the required tolerances; lines 198, 205, 331 and 439 assert the specified F8–F10 results, including rejection of 0.1 for F9. Git tree 670def0 contains the test file and no polarimetry.py, supporting tests-before-implementation ordering. No failing execution was witnessed; checks were prohibited.

checks.criterion: AC4: Test zero/nodata DN, invalid denominators, absence of epsilon, and decoding before averaging, with failing tests first.
checks.evidence: test_polarimetry_decode.py:229–257 tests amplitude-to-power behavior and the 100/300 averaging distinction; lines 263–276 fix zero as INVALID and declared nodata as MISSING; lines 348–376 cover zero, nodata and noise-dominated HH and no epsilon. Implementation at polarimetry.py:269–275 and lines 373–385 matches these cases statically. Required failing and passing executions were not run under the user's restriction.

checks.criterion: AC5: Require explicit angle units, reject unknown units and None, and convert to internal degrees without magnitude inference.
checks.evidence: polarimetry.py:401–417 explicitly validates the unit and selects conversion to degrees. test_polarimetry_decode.py:450–470 covers differing results for 1.0 radians/degrees, magnitude independence, None and unknown units. Runtime behavior was not executed because checks were prohibited.

checks.criterion: AC6: Include Hypothesis properties for positive-DN monotonicity and dB/linear agreement at PRD tolerances.
checks.evidence: test_polarimetry_decode.py:591–610 contains nonempty generated positive-DN inputs, strict monotonicity assertions, and both dB/linear agreement checks using RTOL and ATOL. Hypothesis was not executed because checks were prohibited in this read-only sandbox.

checks.criterion: AC7: Name or parameterize nodata and the 83 dB calibration offset and cite the PRD formula.
checks.evidence: polarimetry.py:247 defines PALSAR2_CALIBRATION_OFFSET_DB=83.0; lines 282 and 309 require explicit nodata arguments. The decode docstrings cite PRD 7 and its formulas; executable formulas at lines 302 and 328 use the offset argument.
